pr_title: fix: upgrade tool ignores node modules and dist
pr_body:
### What does it do?

- switches from 'glob' to 'fast-glob' to support negations
- ignore node_modules and dist paths when running codemods

### Why is it needed?

The upgrade tool was running on node_modules in plugin paths

### How to test it?

codemods should never run on files within a node_modules or dist folder
they should run everywhere else as intended

### Related issue(s)/PR(s)

DX-1599

Fixes #21165

issue_context.title: upgrade tool parses node_modules of plugins, too
issue_context.body:
## Bug report

### Required System information

- Node.js version: 20
- NPM version: 6
- Strapi version: 5-rc.15
- Database: sqlite
- Operating system: mac
- Is your project Javascript or Typescript: js

### Describe the bug

When the upgrade tool is run and it parses a local plugin folder, it parses also its node_modules folder content.

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

1. Create a local plugin inside a project
2. Install its dependencies and so make a node_modules folder exist
3. run the upgrade tool against the whole project

you will get several errors stating files in the node_modules folders, giving evidence that the upgrade tool is parsing them, too

### Expected behavior

node_modules folders of local plugins shouldn’t be parsed
